rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese verb for helping someone or helping with a task.

example.english: I’ll assist you with carrying these things.
example.jyutping: ngo5 bong1 nei5 ling1 di1 je5

rows.note: Use this when the sense is lending a hand, especially with a particular task or activity.

example.english: Thanks for coming to assist on moving day.
example.traditional: 搬屋嗰日，多謝你嚟幫手。
example.jyutping: bun1 uk1 go2 jat6 do1 ze6 nei5 lai4 bong1 sau2

rows.note: Use this formal term in official, professional, or written contexts rather than everyday conversation.

example.english: Our company will assist customers with their applications.
example.traditional: 本公司會協助客戶處理申請。
example.jyutping: bun2 gung1 si1 wui5 hip3 zo6 haak3 wu6 cyu2 lei5 san1 cing2
